body: Listings come from UW–Madison Events and the Wisconsin Union event calendar, read again through the day; Badger Supports programs come from Badger Supports Connect and are labelled as ours. A listing keeps its organizer and a link to its official page, and a cost or a Sold out mark appears only when the source itself states it.

body: Find Your People, one of the interests above, gathers clubs, communities and social and identity-based gatherings, by category — never a hand-picked list. If a listing here is wrong, the official listing on its own source's site is the one that counts.
